best_match.fbbt_definition: Xie et al. (2021) identified two transcriptional clusters at 24h APF as VM7 or VM5v adPNs, but could not distinguish them from each other. Immature neuron that is a precursor to an adult uniglomerular antennal lobe projection neuron adPN (Xie et al., 2021).

justification: VM7 or VM5v adPNs (the authors could not tell which; one of two such clusters): the common parent of immature adult VM7 adPN and VM5v adPN. Up to the pupal stage the immature or pupal term is used (curator); FBbt #2220, release 2026-11-02. Lineage: the authors' per-cell `lineage` for this type in the main analysis: adPN 124, unlabelled 2, lPN 1. kn+ PNs (knot analysis, no lineage column): the paper states they "include six types of adPNs and two vPNs" (Figure 2), i.e. D, DM6, VA1v, VM2, VM7, VM5v (adPN) and the two vPNs.
